## What are the Doshas?

According to Ayurveda, the human body is governed by three primary bio-energies known as doshas—Vata, Pitta, and Kapha. Each individual is born with a distinct proportion of these doshas, forming a personal constitution or prakriti, which remains consistent throughout life.

![Vata](https://www.baidyanath.com/cdn/shop/files/vata-2.png?v=1747317606&width=500)

### Vata

Governed by the elements of air and ether, Vata represents motion, creativity, and communication.

![Pitta](https://www.baidyanath.com/cdn/shop/files/pitta-2.png?v=1747317634&width=500)

### Pitta

Comprising earth and water, Kapha reflects stability, compassion, and endurance.

![Kapha](https://www.baidyanath.com/cdn/shop/files/kapha-2.png?v=1747317653&width=500)

### Kapha

Kapha dosha is comprised of water and earth. It is associated with structure and atability, as well as patience, compassing, and love.
